question: Should Telegram suppress all compaction/system-marked payloads, or should suppression be limited to a typed internal-notice class while preserving `notifyUser` and command/status replies?
rationale: The current patch conflicts with documented compaction notice behavior and treats a shared visible glyph as a transport policy flag, so the permanent Telegram notice boundary needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Narrow Typed Suppression
options.body: Preserve `notifyUser` and system-marked command/status replies, and add a typed marker only for the exact internal notices Telegram should hide.

options.title: Accept Broad Suppression
options.body: Deliberately change Telegram to drop all such notices, with docs/config-contract updates and compatibility proof for existing users.

options.title: Pause Or Close
options.body: Keep this PR paused or close it until there is a concrete user report and proof for the unwanted Telegram notices.

recommendation.title: Narrow Typed Suppression
recommendation.body: Preserve `notifyUser` and system-marked command/status replies, and add a typed marker only for the exact internal notices Telegram should hide.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged compaction delivery repair that defines the adjacent notifyUser behavior this PR would override.
